title: phanera moultonii
intro: Phanera moultonii, commonly known as the Indian copperleaf, is a plant species belonging to the family Moraceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Phanera moultonii include wound healing, pain relief, and treatment of fever and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
